title: Whisperer wurus ci àll bi
intro: Xalaatal benn kampu desert bu yaatu ci diir bu xaar ak ñàkka xam. Njiit lu mag demoon na ndaje ak Yàlla, bàyyi ci ginaaw askan wi yàkkamti dara luñu mëna tëye. Ci noppalu bu metti boobu, amna nit ku am doole ku ñëw ci kanam, ànd ak dige yu leer ak mbindéef bu xarañ buy nuru luy dundu.
clues: Maa ngi nekkoon ci ñi génn Egypt ak Musa, ma gis géej gi xaajaloo ngir nu mëna rëcci.
Ma xool sunu njiit dem ci tundu wi ñeent-fukki guddi ngir am ndigal.
Ma dajale ay takkaay ci nit ñi, defar leen samay loxo.
Ma defar naat buy yuuxu, ma woo nit ñi ñu ñëw ci moom.
Ma jël benn loxo pënd ci yoonu ndaw si, sànni ko ci li ma defar.
Musa daf ma jànkoonte ak moom, teg ma àtte ni ma wax 'bul ma laal' te nu tàqaloo ak man, ñu dige ma ni dina ñu daje ngir àtte ma.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
